extension.summary: 适配 CoreELEC / Kodi 22 的简体中文补全维护版
Simplified Chinese maintained by Jioyzen for CoreELEC / Kodi 22
extension.description: 基于官方简体中文包，包含本分支已完成的系统设置、显示、音频和 CoreELEC 扩展设置翻译补全。保留标准语言 ID 与 zh_CN 区域，兼容皮肤和第三方插件既有的简体中文翻译。
Based on the official Simplified Chinese pack with maintained CoreELEC and Kodi 22 setting translations. Keeps resource.language.zh_cn and zh_CN for compatibility with existing add-on translations.
extension.news: 修复额外内容窗口标题中的全角占位符括号，避免 fmt 格式化异常导致 Kodi 崩溃；校正当前值提示占位符并加入发布前格式检查。
